question: Why would a stopped Earth wipe out all life?
answer: In the hot core, charged particles turn with the Earth, and moving charges make a magnetic field. Stop the spin and that field fades, so cosmic rays reach the ground and damage the DNA of every living thing.
move: Earth’s spin powers the magnetic shield that keeps cosmic rays off our DNA.

web.label: An interactive page asking why a stopped Earth would wipe out all life. A slider labelled Earth's spin, at 100%, shows a magnetic shield around the planet. Dragging the spin to zero makes the shield disappear.
